description: Open a person's kept Selfie and documents by their key, read-only. The key (GR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) is the one the person got on ksaworks.com under Share and be found; it reads what they kept there: the Selfie (its groupings, each item with its band), the documents' names, and the things held (courses and exams) from the kept course history, ready to pass as `held` to checklist_map or will_my_credits_transfer, or `key` itself to those tools. GoldSeam stores nothing; the read is listed for the person under Who has used it. A person with no key yet: give them ksaworks.com/your-evidence to add their documents once.

key.description: The person's Selfie key, e.g. GR-7Q2C-4M8N-1P3R-5T6V

name: open_with_key

documents.description: Each document's name, slot and date; never its contents

held.description: The things held, read from the kept course history, as checklist_map and will_my_credits_transfer take them

selfie.description: The kept Selfie: groupings (dimensions), each item with its band and basis; where_i_stand

title: Open With Key
